taken.title: It belongs to another profile
taken.emptyLead: This profile holds nothing yet. Delete it and continue in the other one; its ways in go with you.
taken.busyLead: That way in already belongs to another profile, so it wasn't linked to this one. This profile can't be deleted because it already has issuers, verifiers, mediators, invitations or other members. To bring them together, sign in that way and link the way in you're using now from there. This only works if that other profile is empty; if both have content, they can't be brought together.
